description:
Reference implementation of the formal model, equilibrium analysis and prospective evaluation protocol of the manuscript Bio-Inspired Resource-Constrained Potential Games for Adaptive Coordination in Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems.

What this software does. It implements the finite frozen-context task-allocation game of Section 4 (feasible action sets under energy, computation, memory and latency caps; shared task rewards; congestion externalities; agent-specific separable costs), and verifies its stated results rather than assuming them: the exact-potential identity of Proposition 1 is checked on every feasible unilateral deviation in exact rational arithmetic; the approximate-equilibrium certificate of Proposition 2 and the uncertainty-gated update rule of Equation (8) are implemented with their error allowances explicit; and the stationary law of Proposition 3, together with the potential-loss bound of Corollary 2, is cross-checked against an independently constructed transition matrix via detailed balance. The constructed two-agent example of Section 6, Table 2 and Equation (15) are reproduced exactly, as is Figure 3. A synthetic Level II harness implements the environment generator, the six prespecified conditions, the baselines B1-B5 and the paired-bootstrap analysis plan.

What this software does not do, and does not claim. No experiment reported in the manuscript has been executed. Level III (trained controllers, physical platforms, measured latency and energy) is not implemented. Synthetic task success is not robot validation and a modelled energy proxy is not a measured power saving. The package demonstrates no energy saving, no superior coordination and no robust real-world autonomy; those remain hypotheses until the corresponding evaluation is performed. The bundled demonstration study runs at a reduced scale and supports no confirmatory claim; the preregistered design of Section 7.2 is provided separately and must be run as specified before any such claim is made.

A Colab-ready notebook reproduces every exact result in a few minutes and runs a small Level II study.
